dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: First, this is one of the few ways you can get out of Aaru Village.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Get out of this desolate dump, and the world will be your oyster! Every young and ambitious soul longs to see the world, no?

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: And we might all be people of the desert, sure, but you can bet that we know how to wrangle Mora off those tree-dwellers!

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Those from the Akademiya have the fattest wallets. They never quibble over prices or delay payments.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: You just need to take one of their commissions, and you'll be set!

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: You won't find a better Mora-making venture anywhere else!
